svg.desc: I build AI agents — and the checks that keep them honest. Now: Rare AI Lab (Prof. Aobo Li) · SIDERIUS, an open-source auto-ML agent for science. Before: AI Agent Development Intern · Pfizer China R&D (2026). Also: I make games · Night Water Academy 夜水书院 (UE5). Drawn as a dotted journal page with washi tape and a taped polaroid of a rainy alley, where a small cat-eared robot stands under a clear umbrella; stamped 検証済.
